description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): A short summary of one place: kind, region, address, and what applies (free or paid, how to reserve, indoor or outdoor, pets, open on Mondays), with the data date and the page URL. Phone numbers, the place's own reservation dates, fee amounts and opening hours are on that page. Takes an id from another tool, or a Korean place name (optionally with a region). When several places share the name, the result lists them. Results are in Korean.

id.description: An id from another tool, e.g. "tennis/장충테니스장".

name.description: A place name in Korean, e.g. "용인자연휴양림", "선산휴게소 상행", "의왕시글로벌도서관". 곳 이름.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

name: get_place
title: 곳 하나 자세히 보기
